description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing Interest Rate Charts in the Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, listing all charts, retrieving specific charts, creating, updating, and deleting interest rate charts. The class employs JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and depends on various service classes for business logic and serialization.

classes.name: InterestRateChartsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing interest rate charts in the Fineract system.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating or updating an interest rate chart, including default values and allowed options.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all interest rate charts associated with a given product ID.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interest rate chart by its ID, with optional association data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new interest rate chart based on the provided JSON request body.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing interest rate chart identified by chartId with data from the provided JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the interest rate chart identified by chartId.
